reason: Investigated all ten assigned news events, corroborated the USFP and Nota pilot announcements and generated two source-grounded software hypotheses.

articles.reason: Securities Times report is afternoon trading movement of defense stocks, no structural repeatable buyer/regulatory change.
Xinhua Shanghai international AI delegation site visit is an enterprise networking event, no supported product-specific workflow requirement.
KAIST innovation award is a personal science recognition event, not a new product/operation delta.
12 Oct NVIDIA/Cisco primary announcement specifies new optical form factor, module-density and efficiency scenarios for data center network buyer; manual comparison workflow can be tested.

opportunities.idea_name: USFP AI Fabric Optical Upgrade Preflight
opportunities.core_job: Compare 200Gb/s-per-lane modules with proposed USFP form-factor deployment in AI fabric expansion
opportunities.target_customer: AI data-center optical-network architects and infrastructure procurement engineers
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-supplied switch slot count, module/lane data, front-panel density, electrical power, cooling/compatibility assumptions; browser-side deterministic bandwidth and kWh option matrix with validation evidence links
opportunities.why_now: NVIDIA and Cisco's 12 October 2026 official USFP announcement proposes 400Gb/s per lane, 12.8Tb/s overall capacity and higher power efficiency; this is a design proposal and not production availability.
opportunities.before_state: Optical lane density, cage fit, endpoint and rack power options are scattered across vendor claims and local plans
opportunities.after_state: Scenario/BOM input → 200G-vs-USFP assumptions → capacity and power delta → incompatible inputs → evidence and human preflight approval
opportunities.evidence_note: Official Cisco announcement states planned, not available, hardware specs; savings remain vendor design estimates.

articles.reason: Bloomberg HT summarizes IAB research on early career employment; workforce trend alone does not define a dated new implementation or compliance workflow.

Nota 13 Oct original Etnews article confirms enterprise AI surveillance cost claim and deployed industrial safety pilots; procurement teams could verify on-site compute economics with a no-camera-API tool.

opportunities.idea_name: Video AI Server Savings Pilot Proof Desk
opportunities.core_job: Audit vendor-declared industrial safety video analytics cost/channel reductions before procurement
opportunities.target_customer: Manufacturing and construction site video-safety procurement and IT teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual baseline cameras/channels, GPU/server watts and costs, before-after observed frame-rate, monitoring edge conditions and test evidence CSV with deterministic TCO/savings range
opportunities.why_now: Nota's 13 October 2026 announcement claims its VLM-based Nota Vision Agent can reduce video surveillance server deployment costs up to 85% and handle twice the channels using same server at ~20 sites.
opportunities.before_state: Vendor efficiency claims and industrial safety camera pilot measurements are not normalized to comparable hardware configurations and recording conditions
opportunities.after_state: Document baseline → vendor claim → real pilot CSV test → normalized channel throughput and server CAPEX delta → acceptance and caution notes
opportunities.evidence_note: 85% is a vendor claim reported by publishers; not independently verified. Tool does not run AI detection or connect to cameras.
